text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe is this year set for another bumper harvest -- with production of most crops expected to record increases of more than 10 percent -- if the present good rainfall pattern continues.

- Zimbabwe Chief Justice Anthony Gubbay on Monday called upon legal practitioners to give free legal presentation to accused persons who are too poor to afford a lawyer and thus cannot be assured of fair trials.
